title: IndyTeer
desc: IndyTeer is a full-stack volunteer-matching platform built with a team as part of a hackathon project, connecting volunteers with local organizations in need of help. Built with React, TypeScript, and Supabase, it features user authentication, organization management, event registration, and volunteer-hour tracking, with database-enforced permissions to keep each user's data secure. The project was developed using AI-assisted workflows with Claude and ChatGPT to speed up development.

title: Recruiting Platform
desc: A football recruiting platform that allows athletes and coaches to create accounts based on their roles. Players will be able to build profiles, display their athletic statistics and school history, while coaches and teams can discover players and manage recruiting opportunities. The platform is designed to connect athletes with teams and simplify the recruiting process.
tech: React.js, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, PostgreSQL

title: Memora
desc: Memora is a Chinese language learning web app designed to help users study and retain vocabulary. The app includes user authentication, a personal dashboard, flashcards, a vocabulary list for saved words, and a spaced repetition system to support long-term memory. The goal of Memora is to make learning Chinese vocabulary simple, organized, and effective.

title: Everything Pasta
desc: Everything Pasta is a conceptual website for pasta enthusiasts to explore and share their love for pasta. While not fully functional, the site allows users to sign up or log in to simulate user authentication. Once logged in, users can search for different types of pasta and contribute by adding their own blog entries. This project demonstrates basic web functionalities like user authentication, search, and content creation, serving as a showcase for frontend and backend development concepts.

title: Yours Truly
desc: Built a C# .NET Worker Service that automatically sends daily prompts generated by the Gemini API via email. Responses are stored in PostgreSQL and distributed to other participants using MailKit once all responses have been received, creating an automated prompt and response exchange service.

title: Chess Guessr
desc: Chess Guessr is an Android app designed to improve chess vision and visualization skills. In the game, users are given a chessboard coordinate, and they must guess the color of the square at that position. It's a fun and engaging way to sharpen one's ability to quickly identify squares on a chessboard, helping players enhance their overall chess game and spatial awareness.

title: Game Time Network
desc: The Game Time Network website is a fully responsive platform built to showcase their growing sports media brand, featuring weekly live shows, podcasts, host profiles, and interviews with major sports figures. The design focuses on clean navigation and bold visuals, making it easy for fans to explore shows like GameTime Live, After Hours, Cot’s Corner, and Following the Pack. With strong community roots and authentic sports conversations, the site gives users a clear and engaging way to connect with the network.

title: Standard Barbecue
desc: The Standard Barbecue website is a personally designed, fully responsive site built for a barbecue sauce company to showcase their lineup of sauces. Visitors can browse each product with bold imagery and clear descriptions, then head straight to the company's Shopify store to place an order. Built with React.js and hosted with HostGator, the site gives the brand a polished online presence that looks great on phones, tablets, and desktops.

title: Synergy 360, LLC
desc: The Synergy 360, LLC website is a personally designed, fully responsive site for a financial planning firm, built to show visitors who they are and the services they offer. The layout focuses on a clean, professional look with clear sections for the firm's story, team, and financial planning services, making it easy for prospective clients to learn about the business and feel confident reaching out. Built with React.js and optimized for every screen size.

title: Justine Ocken
desc: The Justine Ocken website is a personally designed, fully responsive portfolio built to showcase her artwork in a clean, gallery-style layout. Visitors can browse her pieces, learn about her and her creative background on the about page, and use the built-in contact form to request commissions directly. Built with React.js, the site keeps the focus on the art while making it simple for new clients to get in touch from any device.
